title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes (data set: Amphibian pupil data CSV, 1,293 species, and References for pupil data)
note: Complete CSV, ReadMe and reference documentation retrieved. Adult and larval pupil classifications kept separate; larval none was not interpreted as an observed pupil absence.

title: Visual performance of the toad (Bufo bufo) at low light levels: retinal ganglion cell responses and prey-catching accuracy
note: All 12 scanned pages read with OCR; numerical tables and reported exponents checked against page images. No supplementary files listed.

title: Why do animal eyes have pupils of different shapes? (supplementary materials: table S1, list of species with pupil shapes; tables S2 to S4)
note: Main full XML and complete supplementary PDF read; both supplementary movies retrieved. Species-level classifications in original nonbinary analysis matrices cross-checked against all 214 rows of supplementary Table S1. Associated dataset read at https://researchdata.durham.ac.uk/downloads/736664852. Supplement retrieved at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC4643806/supplementaryFiles.

title: Sex and caste-specific variation in compound eye morphology of five honeybee species
note: Complete XML read, including the 15 sex/caste rows of Table 1 and figure captions. No supplementary material listed. Morphology is logged as morphology, without converting facet counts or diameters into acuity or sensitivity.

title: The phylogenetic distribution of ultraviolet sensitivity in birds: Additional file 2 (every species with its violet or ultraviolet type)
note: Full XML and complete supplement read. The published XML has Additional file 1 rather than the batch title’s Additional file 2; it contains 310 species rows. One blank Type (Passer domesticus) is not logged; question marks and paleognath exceptions retained. Assignments from sequencing are grade g and do not claim measured lambda-max or behavioural colour vision.

title: A seabird's eye view: visual fields of some seabirds (Laridae and Procellariidae) from tropical latitudes
note: Complete XML and supplementary DOCX read; all measured cells of Tables S1/S2 logged with missing cells left missing. Main-text rounded values and Table S2 onset labels contain discrepancies, documented in measurement notes. Full fields of view are not derived from ambiguous blind-field headings.

title: Retinal adaptation to dim light vision in spectacled caimans (Caiman crocodilus fuscus): Analysis of retinal ultrastructure
Evolution of colour vision in mammals
Fine structure of the retinal photoreceptors of the great horned owl (Bubo virginianus)
One thousand plant transcriptomes and the phylogenomics of green plants
note: Main article, methods, figures and thirteen free supplementary files inspected. This is a phylogenomic/tree and gene-family study; no measurements of the brief sensory traits. Photosynthetic pigment history is not a measured sensory response.

title: Phytochrome diversity in green plants and the origin of canonical plant phytochromes
note: Main article and full free supplementary PDF. 380 taxon/phylogenetic-class records are sequence evidence, all grade g; no behavioural response or measured species spectral sensitivity is inferred. Two broad-group background records describe reversible Pr/Pfr spectral maxima.

title: Plant photoreceptors: phylogenetic overview
note: Published repository version read, Fig.3 image transcribed and visually checked, publisher supplementary figures 8 and 9 inspected. No supplementary table link exposed on publisher or repository page. Gene evidence stays grade g; putative ULI3 is not treated as a validated photoreceptor; Pinus figure/prose discrepancy retained.

title: Retinal topographic maps: a glimpse into the animals' visual world
note: Complete publisher chapter; four tables and figures read, no supplements listed. Original 12-species snake estimates distinguished from review values. Hexagonal/square estimates remain alternatives; no group mean promoted to species. Source spelling and topography inconsistencies retained in notes.

title: Variability in oil droplet numbers and proportions in the retinas of anole lizards
note: Complete article and figures; no separate supplementary download listed. Exact reported mean proportions/densities retained. Unlabelled individual scatterplot points not invented as numerical counts; raw counts are cited to Campbell (2006). Foveal tissue was excluded. Background pigment spectra explicitly secondary.

title: Vision and the light environment
note: Complete five-page primer from author site, including both figures and further reading. All review/group values remain grade g and scope-limited. Adjacent unrelated articles sharing the first/last journal pages excluded. No supplements listed.

title: Acuity of a Cryptochrome and Vision-Based Magnetoreception System in Birds
note: Complete 10-page main paper and 17-page Supporting Material read; supplement supplied by authors university laboratory at https://www.ks.uiuc.edu/Publications/Papers/PDF/SOLO2010/SOLO2010supp.pdf . Seven secondary experimental summaries grade g and two explicit model predictions grade i; no measured bird angular acuity or observed magnetic visual pattern inferred.
